question: The Bahamani Sultanate was founded by which of the following leaders?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alauddin Hasan Bahman Shah**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Bahmani Sultanate, or the Bahmani empire, was established in 1347 by a Turkish general named Alauddin Bahman Shah.

 
 
• He had revolted against Mohammed bin Tughlaq of the Delhi Sultanate.
